Sentence (English): We replace a 10 year old Maytag with another at the same price point.
Comments (English): [ Quite the disappointment.  ] || ---------------- || We replace a 10 year old Maytag with another at the same price point. Wow, I can't be more disappointed in the product. Fewer options on this one, which was fine because we typically only used 2 or 3 of the cycles on our old dishwasher. But this new one, it doesn't even remember the last wash cycle used. The upper rack must have been designed by someone who doesn't even use a dishwasher. we could load up the old one full of glasses, now on the new one only two rows can support those same glasses. The other three rows don't support the glasses well and then they tip over. This is the same dishwasher just a newer version of our old one, but we can't fit as many dishes in a wash cycle as our old one. I wouldn't recommend this to anyone quite frankly. If I hadn't invested so much time in buying, picking it up, and installing it. I'd return it. In an exercise of self-abuse. everytime I use it, I'll be reminded to buy a Bosch or something better. Sentence (English): Sadly i have to give a mixed review on this.
Comments (English): [ Great cleaning but warranty issues ] || ---------------- || Sadly i have to give a mixed review on this. I really want to love this product but we've had difficulties with the dishwasher and the warranty. The cleaning on this is great, much better then our previous dishwasher, it also with pro dry gets all but a few plastic items dry so thumbs up, love this. The problem though is there's an intermittent issue which definitely isn't right and we can't seem to get it resolved under warranty. A couple months after getting the unit it started making an intermittent grinding sound during certain parts of the cleaning cycle. We had a tech out and He heard it on test mode and agreed it wasn't normal and went ahead and ordered and replaced a part. The dishwasher seemed to be better after this and was great for a couple months. Then the noise came back again. We had someone else out and because it only happens intermittently and didn't happen during the 2min test cycles He said the dishwasher was fine. I had a recording of it and you can clearly hear the sound change. Again the tech said that He couldn't really tell on the video and that it sounded like normal operation. I guarantee a grinding sound isn't normal operation because 1 it didn't do that when we first got it and 2 the other tech previously agreed the same sound was an issue when he heard it in person. Anyway long story short we now have a dishwasher that intermittently makes a really irritating and loud grinding/rubbing rubber sound during certain parts of the cycle in our new dishwasher and there's nothing that can be done. It's for this reason i'm unlikely to buy another KitchenAid product, which is a shame because otherwise i love it.

The cutlery is placed horizontally and it's a bit of a pain to put them in one by one, but I have to admit that this way they stay cleaner. Very happy with the purchase. Great value for money.
Comments (Original): [ Relación calidad-precio, genial ] || ---------------- || Hace un par de semanas que compré este lavavajillas, y hasta el momento funciona genial. Buy the kitchenaid instead.

Sentence (English): I wanted to love this dishwasher — the reviews are all amazing and rave about the features and how quiet it is.
Comments (English): [ Much louder than advertised, unhelpful service ] || ---------------- || I wanted to love this dishwasher — the reviews are all amazing and rave about the features and how quiet it is. Instead, mine operates at 68 dB, not the 46 dB advertised. The manual talks about a sound insulation sheet and pad, so I assumed that must not have been installed by LG's hired installers, because they were in a rush after a long day that had them installing after delivery hours. It's the only thing that would make sense based on reviews. I removed the kick plate to validate that there was no insulation. Thinking LG would be quick to resolve such a silly issue and anxious to have their product operate at the advertised sound level, I called customer service. I spent 40 minutes talking with the rep explaining the situation repeatedly and asking them to ship me the part. She didn't understand and defaulted to only offer me $100 for "inconvenience" or to return it. I wanted LG's 5-star dishwasher and to love it as much as every other customer. I didn't get that or helpful service.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher in mid-July.
Comments (English): [ Wretched Job Cleaning Knives ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher in mid-July. It consistently does an atrocious job cleaning knives. All other objects in the wash load were cleaned normally, i.e., larger bits of food scrapped off. Nothing was included in the load that had high amounts of grease of anything else that could distort the washing (I have had portable dishwashers for over 40 years and know how to load them). I use Finish Quantum Ultimate Powerball soap and Finish Rinse Aid Jet-Dry,Whirlpool sent out a repair person to inspect the unit - he said it is operating as per specifications.What I am left with is scrubbing knives as the Whirlpool has "washed" them and heat baked the detritus on them, or not bothering to put them in the Whirlpool and handwashing them.Outrageous after having spent over $1,000. (taxes included).BUYER BEWARE !

Sentence (English): This is definitely the top performing dishwasher for cleaning that I have ever owned.
Comments (English): [ Fantastic cleaning but overall disappointed ] || ---------------- || This is definitely the top performing dishwasher for cleaning that I have ever owned. Despite that I am not as satisfied as I thought I would be especially considering the cost. I am blown away by how spotless even the dirtiest pans are, and I thought that would be the most important aspect of a dishwasher, but I have learned that for me, it is not. The biggest drawback to this dishwasher is the interior racks. The top rack is divided into five rows with two of them being significantly less wide than the other three. There are times when I just can't fit what I need to clean in them. I am not a fan of the third rack as it limits the height of the items that can go in the top rack. That being said, I absolutely need that third rack due to the design of the bottom rack as I have to put my silverware in there. The back area of the bottom rack loads dishes vertically and the front loads horizontally, and there are often conflicts when loading. I use quite a few cutting boards and the only way I can fit them in the bottom rack without conflict is to remove the silverware basket, so I rarely get to use the basket. Loading my dishwasher used to be a no brainer and boy could I fill up a dishwasher, but it is sort of like a jigsaw puzzle loading this one and I often have to remove dishes and rearrange them. The interior design of this dishwasher just doesn't work for me, but the exterior is sleek looking, and the finish is beautiful and easy to keep clean. I love the top controls as I need to lean against my dishwasher to reach my cabinets and I occasionally caused my previous dishwasher to turn off. The top controls prevent that from happening. I wish I could give this beautiful looking, fabulous cleaning dishwasher a higher rating and I waited quite a while before writing this review as I allowed for a learning curve in loading it, but it hasn't gotten any better for me.

Sentence (English): We've owned this dishwasher for about 2 months now.
Comments (English): [ Very few options and doesn't dry dishes at all ] || ---------------- || We've owned this dishwasher for about 2 months now. From day one, the dishes are soaking wet. The inside of the cabinets, door and racks are covered in water. I have looked in the manual and all over the machine for a vent that might be obstructed and can't find anything. Finally called into GE today and couldn't even get an answer as to whether this machine even HAS drying functionality. They just wanted to schedule a service call which I'm sure would result in "operating as intended" and I'll be on the hook for the bill. All they could tell me was to regurgitate the owners manual troubleshooting steps under "dishes don't dry" which states "Door not opened immediately after Clean light came on" "For proper drying, the dishwasher door must be openedimmediately after the clean light comes on". Really GE? for $900 you can't build a vent into the machine to allow the steam to vent out after the cycle? If I have to wait 160 minutes for the dishwasher to complete it's cycle to be ready to open the door, it kind of defeats the whole "automatic dishwasher" idiom doesn't it? I expected better from GE, but then again, it's all about over promising and under delivering these days isn't it?

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

Comments (English): [ We installed it in our cafe on August 21st. Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it was possible to install it, and the delivery person came to check it again and installed it. (He gave us two instructions, ] || ---------------- || We installed it in our cafe on August 21st. Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it could be installed, and the delivery person came to check again and installed it. (They gave us two instructions: since it is not for home use, there is no heating, so they told us about the risk of freezing, and because there is a water sensor on the floor, we should not do aggressive water cleaning.) After listening to the precautions, we decided to install it. Everyone was kind and we were grateful for the quick installation. Usually, many people install it in their homes, but we wanted to buy it because we wash a lot of dishes in our cafe. Business-use ones are too expensive and consume a lot of electricity, so many people who buy them sell them used. So we bought it for a large home and thought we could use it at home if we didn't use it. I tried it and it's really good. It was like a washing machine, and the dishes were all washed in 1-2 hours, and it's like hiring a part-timer. It's really good. It protects our wrists and stamina. And it really saves time, so we have more free time. Since it's a dessert cafe, baking and washing dishes took up the whole day. I'm really, really glad I bought it. I heard that it is good to pre-wash it, so I washed it with water in advance and it was really clean. Oh, and if you are going to buy it, buy dishwasher detergent before installation. You want to use it right away on the day it is installed. But you can't use it without detergent. We went to the mart and bought an all-in-one detergent and used it right away. It is so, so good. Since cafes usually have water supply, drainage, and electricity, the installer just had to make sure not to wash it. I was grateful that he checked it carefully several times. Those who are tired of washing dishes. Buy it quickly. The fact that you are looking for this is proof that you should buy it. We also put it off and put it off several times, but it was a really good purchase. Oh, and even if you heat-dry it, it doesn't dry completely, so you have to wipe it. But it's still so good. I used to wash the dishes for more than 3-4 hours (excluding the time to wipe it dry). Now, it's really good because I only have to do it in 30 minutes. It feels good to wipe it. I am satisfied because it cleans well :) It's been over a week, and I sing every day that I bought it well.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it could be installed, and the delivery person came to check again and installed it. Usually, many people install it in their homes, but we wanted to buy it because we wash a lot of dishes in our cafe. Since cafes usually have water supply, drainage, and electricity, the installer just had to make sure not to wash it. I was grateful that he checked it carefully several times. Those who are tired of washing dishes. Buy it quickly. The fact that you are looking for this is proof that you should buy it. We also put it off and put it off several times, but it was a really good purchase. Oh, and even if you heat-dry it, it doesn't dry completely, so you have to wipe it. But it's still so good. I am satisfied because it cleans well :) It's been over a week, and I sing every day that I bought it well.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

Sentence (English): It was like a washing machine, and the dishes were all washed in 1-2 hours, and it's like hiring a part-timer.
Comments (English): [ We installed it in our cafe on August 21st. Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it was possible to install it, and the delivery person came to check it again and installed it. (He gave us two instructions, ] || ---------------- || We installed it in our cafe on August 21st. Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it could be installed, and the delivery person came to check again and installed it. (They gave us two instructions: since it is not for home use, there is no heating, so they told us about the risk of freezing, and because there is a water sensor on the floor, we should not do aggressive water cleaning.) After listening to the precautions, we decided to install it. Everyone was kind and we were grateful for the quick installation. Usually, many people install it in their homes, but we wanted to buy it because we wash a lot of dishes in our cafe. Business-use ones are too expensive and consume a lot of electricity, so many people who buy them sell them used. So we bought it for a large home and thought we could use it at home if we didn't use it. I tried it and it's really good. It was like a washing machine, and the dishes were all washed in 1-2 hours, and it's like hiring a part-timer. It's really good. It protects our wrists and stamina. And it really saves time, so we have more free time. Since it's a dessert cafe, baking and washing dishes took up the whole day. I'm really, really glad I bought it. I heard that it is good to pre-wash it, so I washed it with water in advance and it was really clean. Oh, and if you are going to buy it, buy dishwasher detergent before installation. You want to use it right away on the day it is installed. But you can't use it without detergent. We went to the mart and bought an all-in-one detergent and used it right away. It is so, so good. Since cafes usually have water supply, drainage, and electricity, the installer just had to make sure not to wash it. I was grateful that he checked it carefully several times. Those who are tired of washing dishes. Buy it quickly. The fact that you are looking for this is proof that you should buy it. We also put it off and put it off several times, but it was a really good purchase. Oh, and even if you heat-dry it, it doesn't dry completely, so you have to wipe it. But it's still so good. I used to wash the dishes for more than 3-4 hours (excluding the time to wipe it dry). Now, it's really good because I only have to do it in 30 minutes. It feels good to wipe it. I am satisfied because it cleans well :) It's been over a week, and I sing every day that I bought it well.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

I am satisfied because it cleans well :) It's been over a week, and I sing every day that I bought it well.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it could be installed, and the delivery person came to check again and installed it. (They gave us two instructions: since it is not for home use, there is no heating, so they told us about the risk of freezing, and because there is a water sensor on the floor, we should not do aggressive water cleaning.) Usually, many people install it in their homes, but we wanted to buy it because we wash a lot of dishes in our cafe. Since cafes usually have water supply, drainage, and electricity, the installer just had to make sure not to wash it. I was grateful that he checked it carefully several times. Those who are tired of washing dishes. Buy it quickly. The fact that you are looking for this is proof that you should buy it. We also put it off and put it off several times, but it was a really good purchase. Oh, and even if you heat-dry it, it doesn't dry completely, so you have to wipe it. But it's still so good. I am satisfied because it cleans well :) It's been over a week, and I sing every day that I bought it well.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

Usually, many people install it in their homes, but we wanted to buy it because we wash a lot of dishes in our cafe. Those who are tired of washing dishes. Buy it quickly. The fact that you are looking for this is proof that you should buy it. I am satisfied because it cleans well :) It's been over a week, and I sing every day that I bought it well.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it was possible to install it, and the delivery person came to check it again and installed it. (He gave us two instructions, ] || ---------------- || We installed it in our cafe on August 21st. Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it could be installed, and the delivery person came to check again and installed it. (They gave us two instructions: since it is not for home use, there is no heating, so they told us about the risk of freezing, and because there is a water sensor on the floor, we should not do aggressive water cleaning.) After listening to the precautions, we decided to install it. Everyone was kind and we were grateful for the quick installation. Usually, many people install it in their homes, but we wanted to buy it because we wash a lot of dishes in our cafe. Business-use ones are too expensive and consume a lot of electricity, so many people who buy them sell them used. So we bought it for a large home and thought we could use it at home if we didn't use it. I tried it and it's really good. It was like a washing machine, and the dishes were all washed in 1-2 hours, and it's like hiring a part-timer. It's really good. It protects our wrists and stamina. And it really saves time, so we have more free time. Since it's a dessert cafe, baking and washing dishes took up the whole day. I'm really, really glad I bought it. I heard that it is good to pre-wash it, so I washed it with water in advance and it was really clean. Oh, and if you are going to buy it, buy dishwasher detergent before installation. You want to use it right away on the day it is installed. But you can't use it without detergent. We went to the mart and bought an all-in-one detergent and used it right away. It is so, so good. Since cafes usually have water supply, drainage, and electricity, the installer just had to make sure not to wash it. I was grateful that he checked it carefully several times. Those who are tired of washing dishes. Buy it quickly. The fact that you are looking for this is proof that you should buy it. We also put it off and put it off several times, but it was a really good purchase. Oh, and even if you heat-dry it, it doesn't dry completely, so you have to wipe it. But it's still so good. I used to wash the dishes for more than 3-4 hours (excluding the time to wipe it dry). Now, it's really good because I only have to do it in 30 minutes. It feels good to wipe it. I am satisfied because it cleans well :) It's been over a week, and I sing every day that I bought it well.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it could be installed, and the delivery person came to check again and installed it. (They gave us two instructions: since it is not for home use, there is no heating, so they told us about the risk of freezing, and because there is a water sensor on the floor, we should not do aggressive water cleaning.) After listening to the precautions, we decided to install it. Everyone was kind and we were grateful for the quick installation. Usually, many people install it in their homes, but we wanted to buy it because we wash a lot of dishes in our cafe. Business-use ones are too expensive and consume a lot of electricity, so many people who buy them sell them used. So we bought it for a large home and thought we could use it at home if we didn't use it. I tried it and it's really good. It was like a washing machine, and the dishes were all washed in 1-2 hours, and it's like hiring a part-timer. It's really good. It protects our wrists and stamina. And it really saves time, so we have more free time. Since it's a dessert cafe, baking and washing dishes took up the whole day. I'm really, really glad I bought it. I heard that it is good to pre-wash it, so I washed it with water in advance and it was really clean. Oh, and if you are going to buy it, buy dishwasher detergent before installation. You want to use it right away on the day it is installed. But you can't use it without detergent. We went to the mart and bought an all-in-one detergent and used it right away. It is so, so good. Since cafes usually have water supply, drainage, and electricity, the installer just had to make sure not to wash it. I was grateful that he checked it carefully several times. Those who are tired of washing dishes. Buy it quickly. The fact that you are looking for this is proof that you should buy it. We also put it off and put it off several times, but it was a really good purchase. Oh, and even if you heat-dry it, it doesn't dry completely, so you have to wipe it. But it's still so good. I used to wash the dishes for more than 3-4 hours (excluding the time to wipe it dry). Now, it's really good because I only have to do it in 30 minutes. It feels good to wipe it. I am satisfied because it cleans well :) It's been over a week, and I sing every day that I bought it well.

(두가지 안내해주셨는데, 가정에서 사용하는 게 아니다보니 난방이 안되어 동파우려 관련해서 이야기해주셨고, 바닥에 물센서가 있기 때문에 과격한 물청소를 하면 안된다고 하셨어요) 주의사항을 듣고 저희는 설치하기로 마음을 먹었습니다. 다들 친절하시고 빠르게 설치해주셔서 감사했습니다. 원래 보통 가정에 많이들 설치하는데, 저희는 카페 설거지가 많아서 구입하고 싶었어요. 업소용은 너무 비싸고 전기도 많이 먹고 구입하신분들이 중고로 파시는 경우가 많더라구요. 그래서 큰 가정용으로 사고, 안쓰면 집에서 쓰자는 마음으로 구입했어요. 사용해보니 정말 좋아요. 세탁기처럼 1~2시간 안에 설거지가 다 되고, 알바 1명 고용한 셈 치고 있어요. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ  저희의 손목과 체력을 지켜주고 있어요. 그리고 시간이 정말 단축되어 여유가 생겼어요. 디저트카페라 베이킹하고 설거지하면 하루가 다 갔거든요. 정말 너무너무 구입하기 잘했어요. 미리 애벌하면 좋다고 들어서 미리 물로 한번 씻고 하니 정말 잘 세척됩니다. 아참, 구입하실 분들은 설치전에 식기세척기 세제 사두세요 ㅋㅋㅋ 설치된 날 바로 쓰고 싶잖아요. 근데 세제가 없으면 못써요. 저희는 마트 가서 올인원 세제 구입해서 바로 썼습니다. 너무너무 좋아요 ㅠㅠㅠ급수, 배수, 전기 관련해서 카페는 보통 되어 있어서 설치기사님이 세지 않도록 잘 해주시면 되었어요. 꼼꼼하게 여러번 체크해주셔서 감사했습니다.설거지에 지치신 분들....얼른 사세요. 이걸 찾아보고 있다는 것 자체가 여러분이 사셔야하는 증거입니다. ㅋㅋㅋ저희도 미루고 미뤄서 몇번 고민했는데. 진짜 너무 잘 샀어요. 아, 그리고 열건조해도 완전히 바싹 건조는 안되어 닦긴해야해요. 그래도 얼마나 좋아요. 원래 3-4시간 이상(물기닦는 시간 별도) 설거지하고 있었는데. 이제 정말 30분 내로만 하면 되니 좋아요. 닦는 것도 기분이 좋아요. 깨끗하게 잘되어 만족합니다:) 일주일 넘었는데, 매일매일 잘샀다고 노래부르고 있어요.

Comments (English): [ We installed it in our cafe on August 21st. Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it was possible to install it, and the delivery person came to check it again and installed it. (He gave us two instructions, ] || ---------------- || We installed it in our cafe on August 21st. Before purchasing and installing it, we visited to check if it could be installed, and the delivery person came to check again and installed it. (They gave us two instructions: since it is not for home use, there is no heating, so they told us about the risk of freezing, and because there is a water sensor on the floor, we should not do aggressive water cleaning.) After listening to the precautions, we decided to install it. Everyone was kind and we were grateful for the quick installation. Usually, many people install it in their homes, but we wanted to buy it because we wash a lot of dishes in our cafe. Business-use ones are too expensive and consume a lot of electricity, so many people who buy them sell them used. So we bought it for a large home and thought we could use it at home if we didn't use it. I tried it and it's really good. It was like a washing machine, and the dishes were all washed in 1-2 hours, and it's like hiring a part-timer. It's really good. It protects our wrists and stamina. And it really saves time, so we have more free time. Since it's a dessert cafe, baking and washing dishes took up the whole day. I'm really, really glad I bought it. I heard that it is good to pre-wash it, so I washed it with water in advance and it was really clean. Oh, and if you are going to buy it, buy dishwasher detergent before installation. You want to use it right away on the day it is installed. But you can't use it without detergent. We went to the mart and bought an all-in-one detergent and used it right away. It is so, so good. Since cafes usually have water supply, drainage, and electricity, the installer just had to make sure not to wash it. I was grateful that he checked it carefully several times. Those who are tired of washing dishes. Buy it quickly. The fact that you are looking for this is proof that you should buy it. We also put it off and put it off several times, but it was a really good purchase. Oh, and even if you heat-dry it, it doesn't dry completely, so you have to wipe it. But it's still so good. I used to wash the dishes for more than 3-4 hours (excluding the time to wipe it dry). Now, it's really good because I only have to do it in 30 minutes. It feels good to wipe it. I am satisfied because it cleans well :) It's been over a week, and I sing every day that I bought it well.

Comments (English): [ Wretched Job Cleaning Knives ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher in mid-July. It consistently does an atrocious job cleaning knives. The knives come from two different manufacturers, both sets purchased in mid-July, both sets are high quality 18/10 stainless steel. All other objects in the wash load were cleaned normally, i.e., larger bits of food scrapped off. Nothing was included in the load that had high amounts of grease of anything else that could distort the washing (I have had portable dishwashers for over 40 years and know how to load them). I use Finish Quantum Ultimate Powerball soap and Finish Rinse Aid Jet-Dry,. Whirlpool sent out a repair person to inspect the unit - he said it is operating as per specifications. What I am left with is scrubbing knives as the Whirlpool has "washed" them and heat baked the detritus on them, or not bothering to put them in the Whirlpool and handwashing them. Outrageous after having spent over $1,000. (taxes included). BUYER BEWARE !

Sentence (English): Replaced a 13 year old Bosch dishwasher with this one.
Comments (English): [ Solid Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Replaced a 13 year old Bosch dishwasher with this one. The main reason purchased was the price and extra $100 off due to buying two Samsung appliances. So far we like the dishwasher. It has good versatility and the racks accept a variety of dishes. We really like the top 3rd rack for utensils as our old dishwasher didn't have this feature. The unit cleans the dishes well and has a good variety of wash cycles. We also like the drying feature that pops the door open while drying, this seems to aid in drying. The only two negatives we have identified are some utensils in the basket will get caught on the side of the dishwasher as you move the bottom rack in or out. The location of the basket on the right side allows foe this but it's a minor inconvenience. The other nega6in out opinion is you have no idea the dishwasher is clean after a cycle unless you use the Smart Things app. There are no lights on the dishwasher that indicated it completed the wash cycle. We use the drying feature that pops the door open so it's just hard to tell if the dishes are clean without opening and investigating. Overall we like the unit and hope it lasts as long as our previous Bosch.

I'm tempted to only give it 1 but based solely on its basic functionality I give it a 3.My big gripe with the machine the necessity to use an "APP" on a cellphone (or maybe something else) in order to use all of its features. This is really a dumb idea, and I wish Bosch would rethink that decision. All manufacturers of household appliances seem to be jumping on this APP bandwagon. I suspect only for the sake of being able to say so. Who in the world though wants to know recipes provided by the dishwasher ? Yup . that's right. The APP is bloated with useless stuff that severely complicates its use. An APP is just a waste of time and effort. If only the settings options were located on the machine itself then ANYONE could use the machine to is best capabilities. On The Machine . Got it Bosch? Okay rant over. But its really a big issue for us.Plus side is, the machine is amazingly quiet. It washes everything super clean without fuss, without pre-rinsing, and it does so every single time. It's head and shoulders better than our previous 11 year old Acenta Bosch it replaced. NOTE also : a good feature is the ability to adjust up and down the quantity of of Rinse-Aid used. We have an aversion to using that poison At All, so we fill the dispenser with filtered water instead and set it to lowest volume usage. Thus the Fill Rinse Aid Light" isn't on permanently. Hint Hint.

I am greatly disappointed in the quality from LG. I will never buy another one of their products.

I'm tempted to only give it 1 but based solely on its basic functionality I give it a 3. This is really a dumb idea, and I wish Bosch would rethink that decision. All manufacturers of household appliances seem to be jumping on this APP bandwagon. I suspect only for the sake of being able to say so. Who in the world though wants to know recipes provided by the dishwasher ? Yup . that's right. The APP is bloated with useless stuff that severely complicates its use. EVERYONE who needs access to certain settings (certain wash cycles, rinse aid usage settings, Start-Timer, 1/2 Load fast wash, and others) must have access to this app, OR the APP "owner" must set certain favorites up. But , the user has to know what they are and how to activated them. And the big point here is . usually when you start your dishwasher , you are standing right in front of it. An APP is just a waste of time and effort. If only the settings options were located on the machine itself then ANYONE could use the machine to is best capabilities. On The Machine . Got it Bosch? Okay rant over. But its really a big issue for us. Plus side is, the machine is amazingly quiet. It washes everything super clean without fuss, without pre-rinsing, and it does so every single time. It's head and shoulders better than our previous 11 year old Acenta Bosch it replaced. NOTE also : a good feature is the ability to adjust up and down the quantity of of Rinse-Aid used. We have an aversion to using that poison At All, so we fill the dispenser with filtered water instead and set it to lowest volume usage. Thus the Fill Rinse Aid Light" isn't on permanently. Hint Hint.

Sentence (English): The washing machine mostly washes well, but drying is a problem.
Comments (English): [ Drying is insufficient, stains remain ] || ---------------- || The washing machine mostly washes well, but drying is a problem. In 8 months of use, it happened to me maybe 5 times that the dishes were beautifully dried without stains. I note that we have soft water. I clean the dishwasher regularly, and even after cleaning there is no significant improvement. I really regret this choice, for the money we paid for it, I would have expected perfectly clean dishes. Connecting to the app is useful, but even that doesn't work for us anymore. Sentence (English): I brought my dishwasher aunt home because my baby is due to be born in November this year.
Comments (English): [ Auntie Dishwasher is here. I recommend it. ] || ---------------- || I brought my dishwasher aunt home because my baby is due to be born in November this year. I was worried about LG and Samsung, but I chose Samsung because the service is friendlier and the after-sales service is more reliable. And on August 15th, Liberation Day, they held a lot of 815uap events, so I bought it at a cheaper price with the Patriotic Premium. When I ordered, they first visited the sink reform to check the installation location and did the installation. I moved the sink to the oven location. I did that to secure space because I don't use the oven. I paid an additional 50,000 won for the movement, and since there was no separate pillar to support the sink in the installation area, I paid an additional 50,000 won for the support to be placed inside. And I replaced the multi-pipe that can be connected to the sink drain, but it cost 30,000 won, so I paid an additional 130,000 won for the installation and piping. They were kind, and it took a long time because it was a major construction. And the dishwasher arrived the day after the weekend. Two people came to check the color, proceed with the installation, check the operation, and kindly taught me how to use it. Actually, I was wondering if it would wash cleanly, but when I washed the tteokbokki bowl, it cleaned really well. It seems to be stronger than doing it by hand. After washing, there was a little water in the bowl, so I should set the angle of the bowl well and dry it with hot air a little longer. And they explained to me that I should check carefully if there was any water leaking from the connection under the sink, and they wrapped it well with tissue paper. Thank you. I hope it will be of great help to the baby and mom who will be born in November. Thank you. I will use it well. Be happy.
Comments (Original): [ 식세기 이모님 오셨어요. 추천합니다. ] || ---------------- || 올해 11월 아기가 태어날 예정으로 식세기 이모님을 집으로 들였습니다. 엘지와 삼성 고민했는데 서비스가 더 친절하고 as가 더 확실한 삼성으로 선택했습니다. 그리고 8월15일 광복절을 기념으로 815uap이벤트를 많이 해줘서 애국프리미엄으로 더 저렴하게 구매하였습니다. 주문하면 씽크대 리폼 방문을 먼저해서 설치장소를 확인하고 장 공사를 해줍니다. 씽크대 장을 오븐위치로 이동시켰습니다. 오븐 사용을 안해서 공간 확보를 위해 그렇게 했습니다. 장 이동에 5만원 추가금 들었고 설치하는 부분에 장을 지지하는 기둥이 따로 없다고 지지대를 안쪽으로 세우는데 5만원 추가금 들었습니다. 그리고 씽크대 배수구에 연결할수 있는 멀티배관을 교체하였는데 3만원하여 장공사와 배관에 13만원 추가금을 했습니다. 친절하게 해주셨고 대공사라 시간은 많이 걸렸습니다. 그리고 주말지나고 다다음날 식세기가 왔습니다. 두분이 오셔서 색상확인 및 설치진행해주시고 작동확인해주시고 친절히 사용법 알려주셨어요. 사실 깨끗하게 씻어질 지 의문이었는데 떡볶이 그릇을 세척했더니 정말 광나게 잘 닦였습니다. 손으로 하는 것 보다 강력한 것 같습니다. 세척 후 물이 살짝 그릇에 고여있긴 했는데 그릇 각도를 잘 세팅하고 열풍건조를 조금더 길게 해봐야겠습니다. 그리고 씽크대아래 연결부분에 물이 새는지 잘 확인하라고 설명도 해주시고 휴지로 잘 감아주셨습니다. 감사합니다. 아무쪼록 11월에 태어날 아가와 엄마를 위해서 많이 도와줬으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다. 잘쓰겠습니다. 행복하세요.

Sentence (English): We live off the grid (where we produce all of our own power) so we needed a dishwasher that is ENERGY STAR RATED, and our home has an open floorplan, so it needed to be QUIET.
Comments (English): [ We like it (but we don't love it) - here's why… ] || ---------------- || We live off the grid (where we produce all of our own power) so we needed a dishwasher that is ENERGY STAR RATED, and our home has an open floorplan, so it needed to be QUIET. We also wanted a BLACK option to match our other new appliances in our just-finished DIY kitchen. And we wanted to find these three things in a dishwasher UNDER $1,000 to fit our budget. We like this dishwasher because it checked all of those boxes (and it was not easy to find one that did). And we like it because we were very tired of doing dishes by hand for two years in our RV while building our home. And we LOVE THE BOTTLE JETS with clips, which ACTUALLY CLEAN not only water bottles but even oily homemade salad dressing bottles. What we DON'T LOVE is the overall design of the dish racks. Our needs are not fancy. We have successfully utilized very basic dish racks in cheaper models of dishwasher over the decades without any fuss. THIS DISHWASHER RACK has bells and whistles like the aforementioned bottle jets that we love, and a top rack that looks useful but really isn't, and a few other accessories that we are storing under the sink until we can figure out what exactly they do. Using the TOP RACK is like playing dishwasher roulette. Depending on the shape of the item, and how dirty it is, and what may be blocking the stream of water from below… maybe it will get clean, and maybe it won't. Why bother with a “maybe” third rack when you can make more room for the actually useful second rack instead? And here is the thing we ACTIVELY DISLIKE about this dishwasher: we've been using it for several months now and we still don't have a system of where we like to put our PLATES AND BOWLS - especially the small bowls (we're talking about standard Corelle cereal bowls here). They won't stay in place between the awkwardly spaced tines on the second rack, and they take up way too much space on the bottom rack. How can a dishwasher rack designer screw up something as basic as forgetting to include a place to put small bowls? Is this a case of user error? I don't really think we are that stupid. We should be able to find a place for cereal bowls in a dishwasher - and we can't, which is very disappointing. Could we have found the perfect dishwasher? We're not sure, but this isn't quite it.

Comments (English): [ My parents have a sore hand, so after careful consideration, I decided to buy a white 6-person dishwasher. My parents' kitchen is small, so I was worried about the installation. I contacted the delivery person who was going to visit and made a schedule, and asked them to kindly guide me about the space and installation method based on their experience since they are elderly. When I talked to them on the day of the installation, they said that it was not possible to install it due to regulations, and they sent photos to Samsung to check if it was possible, but they said it was not possible, and even though there was a dispenser, they said it would cost 100,000 won to drill the hole. My parents were disappointed because they only followed the regulations, so they looked for a private company (estimate cost of about 250,000 won?) and told me to leave the product behind, saying that they wanted to use it. Since they are elderly, it would have been nice if they had at least explained how to use the product, but I feel so sorry. This opportunity made me think about Samsung appliances again.

Sentence (English): DO NOT BUY DOOR WILL RUST!
Comments (English): [ DO NOT BUY DOOR WILL RUST ] || ---------------- || DO NOT BUY DOOR WILL RUST! I bought this dishwasher in 2022, and a few months late the door started showing signs of rust on the exterior. They did replace the door under warranty, but now about 9 months after the replacement the door is rusting again. The problem is due to a design flaw where the fingerprint resistance film traps water. So the rust cannot be removed without damaging the film and making the door look worse. Maytag will not cover replacing the replacement door leaving me with an ugly dishwasher. Giving 2 stars because functionally the dishwasher works great.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher about a month ago with high hopes, but unfortunately, it has been a letdown.
Comments (English): [ Disappointed ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher about a month ago with high hopes, but unfortunately, it has been a letdown. Several key issues have made this experience quite frustrating. Drying Performance: The most disappointing aspect is that the dishwasher does not effectively dry the dishes. After every cycle, I still find that I have to dry most of the items manually. This issue negates one of the main benefits of having a dishwasher, which is supposed to save time and effort. Cycle Duration: The cycle times are excessively long, often extending beyond 3 hours. This duration is far longer than I anticipated, and it's highly inconvenient when I need clean dishes in a timely manner. It's frustrating to wait so long for something that should be relatively quick, and I'm sure many users can relate to this. App Integration: The app fails to recognize the product. This has prevented me from downloading and accessing custom cycles and features that were advertised. The app was one of the selling points for me, as I was looking forward to managing the dishwasher remotely. Overall Experience: Given these issues, I cannot recommend this dishwasher. The combination of poor drying performance, extended cycle times, and an unreliable app makes it a frustrating appliance to use. However, I remain hopeful that the manufacturer will address these problems in future models or provide a solution for existing customers, which would greatly improve the product's usability.

Once the dishes are done, the door pops open so with multiple people in the house it's easy to know at a glance if the dishes are clean. And it runs really quiet so you won't hear it unless you're right next to it. Don't know what other features you would want for a dishwasher. The surface can attract fingerprints but easy to clean if you care about that.Only had it for about a month but so far no compliments. I also have to run it more frequently because so much space is wasted. To make matters worse, because there is a large gap between vertical rods in the middle of the bottom rack, I had bowls and containers chipped when I dared to put them into that section, as they are beating on each other in this large loose space. The only good thing about this dishwasher is that it is quiet. I can't believe that they ruined what could have been a decent appliance by making these useless racks.

Sentence (English): First of all, the rack design is lacking, it does not easily accommodate small items and seems more geared toward larger plates and pans.
Comments (English): [ Poor Rack Design ] || ---------------- || First of all, the rack design is lacking, it does not easily accommodate small items and seems more geared toward larger plates and pans. The spaces between the bottom of the racks are large, the ridges on the top rack cause items, specifically glasses of any size to fall over. Good luck keeping a small juice glass or the like to stay upright on the rack. Wine glasses also seem quite challenging to secure without them tipping over. Normal things just don't fit well. The bottom rack is not any better it's great for dishes, but we all have more items than dishes to put in the bottom rack. I can go on, but you understand my disappointment with this machine. I bought this because my prior GE dishwasher lasted 20 years, unfortunately this one is poorly designed for normal items. I regret the purchase and am now stuck with an expensive appliance that I deem poorly designed for normal household use. The best thing I could say it is it quieter than my previous GE but that's about all I can say good about this machine. I would NOT recommend it ever.

Comments (English): The design is simple. A typical dishwasher only has two compartments, the upper and lower, but there is a separate, flat shelf at the very top where you can neatly place spoons. Comments (English): [ They don't call me aunt for nothing! ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review written after purchasing it myself. Product name: LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher 14-person DUE6BGL2 Reason for purchase) It took me two months to decide to buy a dishwasher. I hope this helps those who have difficulty making decisions like me. <<< Things to consider when purchasing a dishwasher >>> 1. Secure space to install It is important to choose between a built-in product (to be placed under the sink) or a freestanding product (to be placed next to the sink or in other spaces). < Note > If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range due to its location, installing the dishwasher under a gas range > possible Installing the dishwasher under an induction > not possible Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, and the steam can flow into the induction cooktop, which can cause a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said that installing the dishwasher under an induction cooktop is not possible. However, depending on the manufacturer, there are places where installation is completely impossible, and some people install it by adding space between the induction and the dishwasher, or by purchasing and installing an induction floating frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it is essential to check the installation possibility and conditions for each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, it is essential to check the height of the mop holder. The product you can choose varies depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Product name: LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher 14-person DUE6BGL2 Reason for purchase) It took me two months to decide to buy a dishwasher. I hope this helps those who have difficulty making decisions like me. <<< Things to consider when purchasing a dishwasher >>> 1. Secure space to install It is important to choose between a built-in product (to be placed under the sink) or a freestanding product (to be placed next to the sink or in other spaces). < Note > If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range due to its location, installing the dishwasher under a gas range > possible Installing the dishwasher under an induction > not possible Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, and the steam can flow into the induction cooktop, which can cause a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said that installing the dishwasher under an induction cooktop is not possible. However, depending on the manufacturer, there are places where installation is completely impossible, and some people install it by adding space between the induction and the dishwasher, or by purchasing and installing an induction floating frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it is essential to check the installation possibility and conditions for each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, it is essential to check the height of the mop holder. The product you can choose varies depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products had a mop holder height of 15 cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a mop holder height of 10 cm has increased, the specifications of dishwashers have also changed. That is why I chose an LG product that allows you to choose the mop holder height. For reference, Sam only has a product with a 10 cm mop holder, and when installed in a house with a 15 cm mop holder, a mop holder installation is required. 3. A 14-person dish is recommended over a 12-person dish. If you stack the dishes too tightly, they will not be washed or dried properly between each other. Also, if you want to use it with frying pans and pots, the bigger the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height increase and the expanded loading space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. It is better to have hot air drying than not. Although it is said that basic drying is done in the dryer, it is difficult to wait for the dishes to dry when there are a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. It is definitely better to use hot air drying than to wipe the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. In addition, I wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since the features I wanted were only available in the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that product. Advantage) As expected, LG! Delivery on the desired date is possible, and I was very satisfied with the speed and neatness from the pre-information to the installation. This 14-person hot air drying + steam model to be released in 2024 is a product that has all the core functions of LG dishwashers. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the height-adjustable basket, allowing for storage of tall tumblers or large pots, and the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While these may seem like small differences compared to the core features, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end products would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product's value and ease of use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food and pre-washing with water before loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour by default, and more than two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do it myself than pre-wash. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and doesn't work. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note> After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. They said it could be due to detergent residue, so I replaced the solid detergent I was using with a liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the garbage net is necessary. If you experience the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Additional drawbacks I noticed after 3 months of use - The teeth that hold the dishes in the basket are slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it sticks. I had to press it hard with my hand to put it back in place, but it was not easy in places that were very tilted. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Comments (English): [ They don't call me aunt for nothing! ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review written after purchasing it myself. Product name: LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher 14-person DUE6BGL2 Reason for purchase) It took me two months to decide to buy a dishwasher. I hope this helps those who have difficulty making decisions like me. <<< Things to consider when purchasing a dishwasher >>> 1. Secure space to install It is important to choose between a built-in product (to be placed under the sink) or a freestanding product (to be placed next to the sink or in other spaces). < Note > If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range due to its location, installing the dishwasher under a gas range > possible Installing the dishwasher under an induction > not possible Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, and the steam can flow into the induction cooktop, which can cause a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said that installing the dishwasher under an induction cooktop is not possible. However, depending on the manufacturer, there are places where installation is completely impossible, and some people install it by adding space between the induction and the dishwasher, or by purchasing and installing an induction floating frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it is essential to check the installation possibility and conditions for each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, it is essential to check the height of the mop holder. The product you can choose varies depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products had a mop holder height of 15 cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a mop holder height of 10 cm has increased, the specifications of dishwashers have also changed. That is why I chose an LG product that allows you to choose the mop holder height. For reference, Sam only has a product with a 10 cm mop holder, and when installed in a house with a 15 cm mop holder, a mop holder installation is required. 3. A 14-person dish is recommended over a 12-person dish. If you stack the dishes too tightly, they will not be washed or dried properly between each other. Also, if you want to use it with frying pans and pots, the bigger the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height increase and the expanded loading space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. It is better to have hot air drying than not. Although it is said that basic drying is done in the dryer, it is difficult to wait for the dishes to dry when there are a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. It is definitely better to use hot air drying than to wipe the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. In addition, I wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since the features I wanted were only available in the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that product. Advantage) As expected, LG! Delivery on the desired date is possible, and I was very satisfied with the speed and neatness from the pre-information to the installation. This 14-person hot air drying + steam model to be released in 2024 is a product that has all the core functions of LG dishwashers. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the height-adjustable basket, allowing for storage of tall tumblers or large pots, and the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While these may seem like small differences compared to the core features, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end products would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product's value and ease of use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food and pre-washing with water before loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour by default, and more than two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do it myself than pre-wash. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and doesn't work. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note> After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. They said it could be due to detergent residue, so I replaced the solid detergent I was using with a liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the garbage net is necessary. If you experience the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Additional drawbacks I noticed after 3 months of use - The teeth that hold the dishes in the basket are slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it sticks. I had to press it hard with my hand to put it back in place, but it was not easy in places that were very tilted. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

I hope this helps those who have difficulty making decisions like me. <<< Things to consider when purchasing a dishwasher >>> 1. Secure space to install It is important to choose between a built-in product (to be placed under the sink) or a freestanding product (to be placed next to the sink or in other spaces). < Note > If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range due to its location, installing the dishwasher under a gas range > possible Installing the dishwasher under an induction > not possible Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, and the steam can flow into the induction cooktop, which can cause a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said that installing the dishwasher under an induction cooktop is not possible. However, depending on the manufacturer, there are places where installation is completely impossible, and some people install it by adding space between the induction and the dishwasher, or by purchasing and installing an induction floating frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it is essential to check the installation possibility and conditions for each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, it is essential to check the height of the mop holder. The product you can choose varies depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products had a mop holder height of 15 cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a mop holder height of 10 cm has increased, the specifications of dishwashers have also changed. That is why I chose an LG product that allows you to choose the mop holder height. For reference, Sam only has a product with a 10 cm mop holder, and when installed in a house with a 15 cm mop holder, a mop holder installation is required. 3. A 14-person dish is recommended over a 12-person dish. If you stack the dishes too tightly, they will not be washed or dried properly between each other. Also, if you want to use it with frying pans and pots, the bigger the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height increase and the expanded loading space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. It is better to have hot air drying than not. Although it is said that basic drying is done in the dryer, it is difficult to wait for the dishes to dry when there are a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. It is definitely better to use hot air drying than to wipe the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. In addition, I wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since the features I wanted were only available in the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that product. Advantage) As expected, LG! Delivery on the desired date is possible, and I was very satisfied with the speed and neatness from the pre-information to the installation. This 14-person hot air drying + steam model to be released in 2024 is a product that has all the core functions of LG dishwashers. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the height-adjustable basket, allowing for storage of tall tumblers or large pots, and the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While these may seem like small differences compared to the core features, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end products would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product's value and ease of use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food and pre-washing with water before loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour by default, and more than two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do it myself than pre-wash. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and doesn't work. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note> After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. They said it could be due to detergent residue, so I replaced the solid detergent I was using with a liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the garbage net is necessary. If you experience the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Additional drawbacks I noticed after 3 months of use - The teeth that hold the dishes in the basket are slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it sticks. I had to press it hard with my hand to put it back in place, but it was not easy in places that were very tilted. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Product name: LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher 14-person DUE6BGL2 Reason for purchase) It took me two months to decide to buy a dishwasher. I hope this helps those who have difficulty making decisions like me. <<< Things to consider when purchasing a dishwasher >>> 1. Secure space to install It is important to choose between a built-in product (to be placed under the sink) or a freestanding product (to be placed next to the sink or in other spaces). < Note > If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range due to its location, installing the dishwasher under a gas range > possible Installing the dishwasher under an induction > not possible Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, and the steam can flow into the induction cooktop, which can cause a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said that installing the dishwasher under an induction cooktop is not possible. However, depending on the manufacturer, there are places where installation is completely impossible, and some people install it by adding space between the induction and the dishwasher, or by purchasing and installing an induction floating frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it is essential to check the installation possibility and conditions for each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, it is essential to check the height of the mop holder. The product you can choose varies depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products had a mop holder height of 15 cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a mop holder height of 10 cm has increased, the specifications of dishwashers have also changed. That is why I chose an LG product that allows you to choose the mop holder height. For reference, Sam only has a product with a 10 cm mop holder, and when installed in a house with a 15 cm mop holder, a mop holder installation is required. 3. A 14-person dish is recommended over a 12-person dish. If you stack the dishes too tightly, they will not be washed or dried properly between each other. Also, if you want to use it with frying pans and pots, the bigger the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height increase and the expanded loading space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. It is better to have hot air drying than not. Although it is said that basic drying is done in the dryer, it is difficult to wait for the dishes to dry when there are a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. It is definitely better to use hot air drying than to wipe the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. In addition, I wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since the features I wanted were only available in the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that product. Advantage) As expected, LG! Delivery on the desired date is possible, and I was very satisfied with the speed and neatness from the pre-information to the installation. This 14-person hot air drying + steam model to be released in 2024 is a product that has all the core functions of LG dishwashers. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the height-adjustable basket, allowing for storage of tall tumblers or large pots, and the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While these may seem like small differences compared to the core features, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end products would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product's value and ease of use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food and pre-washing with water before loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour by default, and more than two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do it myself than pre-wash. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and doesn't work. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note> After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. They said it could be due to detergent residue, so I replaced the solid detergent I was using with a liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the garbage net is necessary. If you experience the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Additional drawbacks I noticed after 3 months of use - The teeth that hold the dishes in the basket are slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it sticks. I had to press it hard with my hand to put it back in place, but it was not easy in places that were very tilted. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.
