Product Name: LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Dishwasher. DUE6BGL2. Reason for Purchase) It took me two months to decide on a dishwasher. I hope this helps anyone who, like me, is having trouble making a decision. <<< Things to Consider When Buying a Dishwasher >>>. 1. Secure installation space. Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Product Name: LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Dishwasher. DUE6BGL2. Reason for Purchase) It took me two months to decide on a dishwasher. I hope this helps anyone who, like me, is having trouble making a decision. <<< Things to Consider When Buying a Dishwasher >>>. 1. Secure installation space. Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Comments (English): [ They don't call me aunt for nothing! ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a dishwasher I purchased myself. Product Name: LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Dishwasher. DUE6BGL2. Reason for Purchase) It took me two months to decide on a dishwasher. I hope this helps anyone who, like me, is having trouble making a decision. <<< Things to Consider When Buying a Dishwasher >>>. 1. Secure installation space. Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Product Name: LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Dishwasher. DUE6BGL2. Reason for Purchase) It took me two months to decide on a dishwasher. I hope this helps anyone who, like me, is having trouble making a decision. <<< Things to Consider When Buying a Dishwasher >>>. 1. Secure installation space. Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Comments (English): [ They don't call me aunt for nothing! ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a dishwasher I purchased myself. Product Name: LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Dishwasher. DUE6BGL2. Reason for Purchase) It took me two months to decide on a dishwasher. I hope this helps anyone who, like me, is having trouble making a decision. <<< Things to Consider When Buying a Dishwasher >>>. 1. Secure installation space. Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Comments (English): [ They don't call me aunt for nothing! ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a dishwasher I purchased myself. Product Name: LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Dishwasher. DUE6BGL2. Reason for Purchase) It took me two months to decide on a dishwasher. I hope this helps anyone who, like me, is having trouble making a decision. <<< Things to Consider When Buying a Dishwasher >>>. 1. Secure installation space. Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Product Name: LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Dishwasher. DUE6BGL2. Reason for Purchase) It took me two months to decide on a dishwasher. I hope this helps anyone who, like me, is having trouble making a decision. <<< Things to Consider When Buying a Dishwasher >>>. 1. Secure installation space. Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Product Name: LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Dishwasher. DUE6BGL2. Reason for Purchase) It took me two months to decide on a dishwasher. I hope this helps anyone who, like me, is having trouble making a decision. <<< Things to Consider When Buying a Dishwasher >>>. 1. Secure installation space. Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

I hope this helps anyone who, like me, is having trouble making a decision. <<< Things to Consider When Buying a Dishwasher >>>. 1. Secure installation space. Choose between a built-in product (for use under the sink) or a freestanding model (for use next to the sink or other space). <Note>. If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

If you want to install the dishwasher under an induction or gas range, you can. Installing a dishwasher under a gas range is possible. Installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. Induction cooktops generate heat and steam downwards, while dishwashers generate heat upwards. This can cause a short circuit, and steam can flow into the induction cooktop, potentially causing a malfunction. The LG technician who came to my house said installing a dishwasher under an induction range is not possible. However, some manufacturers make installation impossible, others require space between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, or purchase and install an induction stand frame. Therefore, if you need to install a dishwasher under an induction cooktop, it's essential to check the installation availability and conditions with each manufacturer. 2. For built-in products, checking the mop holder height is essential. The available products vary depending on the height of the sink mop holder. Most products have a mop holder height of 15cm, but recently, as the number of apartments with a 10cm mop holder height has increased, dishwasher specifications have also changed. Therefore, I chose an LG product that allows for a choice of mop holder heights. For reference, Sam only has a 10cm mop holder, and installing it in a home with a 15cm mop holder requires installing a mop holder. 3. A 14-person model is recommended over a 12-person model. Stacking dishes too tightly will prevent them from being washed or dried properly. Also, if you want to use them with frying pans and pots, the larger the size, the better. For reference, the 12-person and 14-person models differ in the maximum shelf height and the expanded storage space due to the larger cup shelf. 4. Having a hot air dryer is better than not having one. Although the dryer does basic drying, it can be difficult to wait for a lot of dishes or on days when the dishwasher is used frequently. Using a hot air dryer is definitely better than wiping the remaining moisture with a dishcloth. I also wanted a frying pan holder and internal lighting, but since those features were only available on the highest model, I gave up on adding a few hundred thousand won and chose that model. Pros) As expected, LG! They offer delivery on the desired date, and I was very satisfied with the smooth and neat process from pre-instruction guidance to installation. This 14-person model, which will be released in 2024, has all the core features of an LG dishwasher with a hot air dryer and steam. Another advantage is the water softener, which significantly reduces water stains. What I find particularly convenient is the ability to adjust the basket height to accommodate tall tumblers or large pots, as well as the separate storage space for scissors and knives. While this may seem like a minor difference compared to the core functionality, these small details add to the user's convenience. High-end models would be even better, but for this price, I'm satisfied with the product, as it offers excellent value for money and is completely comfortable to use. Cons: Pre-washing the dishes is essential. Emptying the food, pre-rinsing with water, and then loading the dishwasher makes it easier to maintain. The dishwasher takes an hour on a basic cycle, and over two hours with hot air drying. Therefore, I'd rather do the pre-wash myself. Some people also complain that the dishwasher runs too long and they don't use it. Please consider these factors carefully before purchasing. <Note>. After using this product for about three weeks, I contacted the service center due to a strong chemical smell. I thought it could be due to detergent residue, so I switched from using solid detergent to liquid capsule detergent, and miraculously, the problem was resolved. Regular cleaning and maintenance of the dishwasher waste screen is still necessary. If you have the same problem as me while using it, I recommend changing the detergent first. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Additional drawbacks I noticed after using it for 3 months. - The comb that holds the dishes in the basket is slanted. When I place a heavy pot or frying pan on it, it tilts slightly and I can see one or two places where it is stuck. I pressed hard with my hand to put it back in place, but the places that are very tilted are not easy. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Overall) I don't call it "auntie" for nothing. If you decide to buy it, I recommend buying it as soon as possible. Dinner time has become much easier! Since I thought it over carefully and made the decision, my satisfaction is the highest. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it if you want a product with the best specifications and good value for money.

Sentence (English): This is my first ever dishwasher and I did a lot of research.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || This is my first ever dishwasher and I did a lot of research. I kept coming back to the Bosch 500 but I was convinced to go with the Bosch 800 based on a few more bells and whistles, and that it was the quietest. This thing has made my home life a lot less stressful. It's used at least three times a week and it gets my dishes squeaky clean. Extremely quiet, I'm glad it has a little light near the handle that stays on when it's running, otherwise I'd have a hard time knowing if it was on or not. I'm using Cascade Platinum washing pods and liquid Finish Jet Dry rinse agent. Very pleased with the results. The only drawback, and this is common with ALL dishwashers, is that some cup bottoms and plastic covers get a small pool of water left in them. It's all due to the angle that the dish was left in. Not a big deal by any means, but I'm still looking at the best way to align these problematic dishes. Installation was time consuming as I had to get a section of my 1950 era hard wood counter top and shelves retrofitted so the dishwasher could go there. Took an electrician, a plumber, and my go to contractor to create this. Now that it's in and running for almost 2 months, I have to say this was a great kitchen investment that I wish I had made years ago. I love my Bosch 800!

Sentence (English): We purchased the top-of-the-line Bosch dishwasher for our busy home and are pleased with how clean the dishes are, however loading takes longer as it has so many ways to fit items.
Comments (English): [ cleans well, communicates poorly ] || ---------------- || We purchased the top-of-the-line Bosch dishwasher for our busy home and are pleased with how clean the dishes are, however loading takes longer as it has so many ways to fit items. Silverware is the worst as each piece needs to be laid in an individual slot, and when closing the top rack too hard they all fall out of said slots. But the worst part of the design is that when the door is closed, there's no indicator as to whether the dishes inside are dirty or clean. A chime rings and it displays "CLEAN" as long as you're standing in the kitchen, but more often than not it finishes the cycle when we are away. The solution involves putting a magnet on the front that we need to manually change to CLEAN/DIRTY each time we run it. Seems stupid to need to do this on a top-of-the-line product but that's how they designed it for whatever reason.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher in 2022.
Comments (English): [ Excellent dishwasher, but.  ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher in 2022. The first 2 units arrived with damage from shipping. The 3rd dishwasher arrived in pristine condition and was installed.I have been very pleased with its performance. All dishes come our spotless. After 26 months of flawless operation the dishwasher stopped mid cycle and displayed an error code for drain pump. I called an appliance repairman since it was 2 months beyond my warranty period. The repairman replaced the drain pump and the dishwasher is now operating as it did before.The cost to replace the drain pump was over $300 for a relatively new unit. I have always considered KitchenAid to be top quality and I was both surprised and disheartened to experience a failure after only 2 years.

There is no light to let you know when the dishwasher is done and there is a clean load that needs to be unloaded. Also the delay button you have to keep pressed to get to something like 2 or 3 hours which we typically use. FYI I hear there is a midyear change (at least for the box store version that removed the delay button on the 800 series and you have to use the app to start a delay run every time! ). The favorite button does not store a custom delay which makes it pretty useless. If you select a bunch of options and want to cancel before starting, you have to "reset" it which takes about a minute and a half to run a drain cycle (even if you never started due to delay setting). All in all, this is a good quality dishwasher that I'm sure will last a long time. However I feel it is lacking in some basic features that dishwashers 10+ years ago had and it pushes you too much to use their app.

I received many recommendations from people around me, and I have many guests at home, and I always had a lot of dishes to wash, so I was always worried and was looking into renting. My husband was comparing it with those of large companies, and he knew about this one too! It was a great opportunity! I wanted it to be installed on Friday, but it was late due to a lack of parts, so I ordered it on the 4th and it was installed on the 17th! But I waited for it no matter what! I was able to use it in a large size because I had a good opportunity with Coupang! The 12-person model is installed on the sink, and since it is a high-end model, we were able to build it in, so we built it neatly into the sink, and if you want to take it out separately and use it, there is a lid. They said you can put an induction stove on top of the lid and use it! Self-installation costs about 100,000 won, but I am even more satisfied because Coupang supported it~~^^ Built-in installation must be 60 wide. Our sink is facing the living room, and the water faucet is under the faucet, so we placed it next to the gas range! Originally, we had to take out all the storage space where the oil and seasonings were! When I looked, they had completely disassembled the sink. They said that we could take the dishwasher with the previous installation when we move next time, or we could put the sink back in and move it back, so we had to store it. So we stored it on the veranda, and they even moved the separated sink! The two technicians were so kind and helpful! I was so grateful^^ Design Viewer? It's neat in dark silver! I also like that it's not a mirror type, so it doesn't get fingerprints on it^^ A simple user manual is attached, and it's a touch-type, so it doesn't seem too difficult! Power/Up/down wash selection/Storage/Auto door open/Program/Reservation/Lock/UV/Powerful wash/Start/Stop The pictures are simple! It's easy to follow the manual! You need to buy a dedicated detergent, and when you open the door, press the blue button on the side of the door and the lid opens with a click! Put a little dedicated detergent, close the detergent cover, and you're done! There's also a rinse container next to it, but they say you don't need to rinse these days^^ They say that rinse is to get rid of the water droplets forming on the plates, but they say that if you dry them well, it's not really necessary! There are internal components like cutlery tray/upper tray/upper washing wing/lower tray/spoon basket. To raise the upper tray, lift the locks on both sides until you hear a click, and when you raise the locks on both sides of the tray, the upper tray goes down and you can adjust the position. For the cutlery tray, lift the right tray and slide it to the upper part to use it by folding it, so there is more space, so you can put tall items like tumblers, which seems good. Also, when it is folded, you can lift the right tray up and remove it for use! I like it because it seems to utilize the space well. I am still not good at using dishwashers, so I need to ask YouTube or acquaintances and read the user manual a lot! They say that the way to arrange the dishes is important! On the upper tray, put light tableware such as cups, plates, and small bowls/tableware that is not heavily soiled/be careful not to obstruct the rotation of the washing wings! Lower tray is for pots, lids, large plates, large bowls. Place plates and chopsticks on the side of the basket. / Lower is for heavily soiled tableware. Place spoons and chopsticks in the spoon basket with the direction in which food touches them facing upwards and make sure they do not overlap! If they are heavily soiled, wipe them dry! Be careful not to let sharp edges stick out between the spoon trays! I will read the user manual thoroughly and use it even more diligently from now on! Oh! I was even more and more and more surprised because it was quieter than I thought~~~~~~ Very satisfied! My husband was comparing it with those of large companies, and he knew about this one too! It was a great opportunity! Self-installation costs about 100,000 won, but I am even more satisfied because Coupang supported it~~^^ Built-in installation must be 60 wide. Our sink is facing the living room, and the water faucet is under the faucet, so we placed it next to the gas range! Originally, we had to take out all the storage space where the oil and seasonings were! When I looked, they had completely disassembled the sink. They said that we could take the dishwasher with the previous installation when we move next time, or we could put the sink back in and move it back, so we had to store it. So we stored it on the veranda, and they even moved the separated sink! The two technicians were so kind and helpful! I was so grateful^^ Design Viewer? It's neat in dark silver! I also like that it's not a mirror type, so it doesn't get fingerprints on it^^ A simple user manual is attached, and it's a touch-type, so it doesn't seem too difficult! Power/Up/down wash selection/Storage/Auto door open/Program/Reservation/Lock/UV/Powerful wash/Start/Stop The pictures are simple! It's easy to follow the manual! You need to buy a dedicated detergent, and when you open the door, press the blue button on the side of the door and the lid opens with a click! Put a little dedicated detergent, close the detergent cover, and you're done! There's also a rinse container next to it, but they say you don't need to rinse these days^^ They say that rinse is to get rid of the water droplets forming on the plates, but they say that if you dry them well, it's not really necessary! There are internal components like cutlery tray/upper tray/upper washing wing/lower tray/spoon basket. To raise the upper tray, lift the locks on both sides until you hear a click, and when you raise the locks on both sides of the tray, the upper tray goes down and you can adjust the position. For the cutlery tray, lift the right tray and slide it to the upper part to use it by folding it, so there is more space, so you can put tall items like tumblers, which seems good. Also, when it is folded, you can lift the right tray up and remove it for use! I like it because it seems to utilize the space well. I am still not good at using dishwashers, so I need to ask YouTube or acquaintances and read the user manual a lot! They say that the way to arrange the dishes is important! On the upper tray, put light tableware such as cups, plates, and small bowls/tableware that is not heavily soiled/be careful not to obstruct the rotation of the washing wings! Lower tray is for pots, lids, large plates, large bowls. Place plates and chopsticks on the side of the basket. / Lower is for heavily soiled tableware. Place spoons and chopsticks in the spoon basket with the direction in which food touches them facing upwards and make sure they do not overlap! If they are heavily soiled, wipe them dry! Be careful not to let sharp edges stick out between the spoon trays! I will read the user manual thoroughly and use it even more diligently from now on! Oh! I was even more and more and more surprised because it was quieter than I thought~~~~~~ Very satisfied! My husband was comparing it with those of large companies, and he knew about this one too! It was a great opportunity! I wanted it to be installed on Friday, but it was late due to a lack of parts, so I ordered it on the 4th and it was installed on the 17th! But I waited for it no matter what! I was able to use it in a large size because I had a good opportunity with Coupang! The 12-person model is installed on the sink, and since it is a high-end model, we were able to build it in, so we built it neatly into the sink, and if you want to take it out separately and use it, there is a lid. They said you can put an induction stove on top of the lid and use it! Self-installation costs about 100,000 won, but I am even more satisfied because Coupang supported it~~^^ Built-in installation must be 60 wide. Our sink is facing the living room, and the water faucet is under the faucet, so we placed it next to the gas range! Originally, we had to take out all the storage space where the oil and seasonings were! When I looked, they had completely disassembled the sink. They said that we could take the dishwasher with the previous installation when we move next time, or we could put the sink back in and move it back, so we had to store it. So we stored it on the veranda, and they even moved the separated sink! The two technicians were so kind and helpful! I was so grateful^^ Design Viewer? It's neat in dark silver! I also like that it's not a mirror type, so it doesn't get fingerprints on it^^ A simple user manual is attached, and it's a touch-type, so it doesn't seem too difficult! Power/Up/down wash selection/Storage/Auto door open/Program/Reservation/Lock/UV/Powerful wash/Start/Stop The pictures are simple! It's easy to follow the manual! You need to buy a dedicated detergent, and when you open the door, press the blue button on the side of the door and the lid opens with a click! Put a little dedicated detergent, close the detergent cover, and you're done! There's also a rinse container next to it, but they say you don't need to rinse these days^^ They say that rinse is to get rid of the water droplets forming on the plates, but they say that if you dry them well, it's not really necessary! There are internal components like cutlery tray/upper tray/upper washing wing/lower tray/spoon basket. To raise the upper tray, lift the locks on both sides until you hear a click, and when you raise the locks on both sides of the tray, the upper tray goes down and you can adjust the position. For the cutlery tray, lift the right tray and slide it to the upper part to use it by folding it, so there is more space, so you can put tall items like tumblers, which seems good. Also, when it is folded, you can lift the right tray up and remove it for use! I like it because it seems to utilize the space well. On the upper tray, put light tableware such as cups, plates, and small bowls/tableware that is not heavily soiled/be careful not to obstruct the rotation of the washing wings! Lower tray is for pots, lids, large plates, large bowls. Place plates and chopsticks on the side of the basket. / Lower is for heavily soiled tableware. Place spoons and chopsticks in the spoon basket with the direction in which food touches them facing upwards and make sure they do not overlap! If they are heavily soiled, wipe them dry! Be careful not to let sharp edges stick out between the spoon trays! I will read the user manual thoroughly and use it even more diligently from now on! Oh! Sentence (English): After our house flooded with Hurricane Harvey the one thing I was excited about ordering were new appliances.
Comments (English): [ DON'T BUY ] || ---------------- || After our house flooded with Hurricane Harvey the one thing I was excited about ordering were new appliances. I love the styling, features, and quality of KitchenAid products and was thrilled to purchase the 25.8 Cu. Ft. French Door refrigerator (KRMF706ESS), the beautiful dishwasher with a 3rd rack (KDTE304GPS), the 30\" Double Oven with convection (KODE500ESS), and an enormous Microwave with a removable shelf for lots of options (KNHP519ESS) which had a special cherry cabinet built around it. Our kitchen was finally ready, just in time for Christmas 2018. The refrigerator was the first to have issues, with the ice maker leaking, stopping, freezing the entire thing up which had to be thawed with a hair dryer. We replaced the ice container 6/20, motor, seal and shaft 8/20, I/M leaking and stopped cooling on both sides 6/22. In August 2023 the entire fridge had quit working correctly and would have cost over 1K for parts which 'might' have solved the issue. Sadly our wonderful microwave started making a loud noise and quit running October 2023 and the technician gave us the news that the Magnetron shorted, and couldn't be fixed. We have a whole house surge protector so we know it wasn't caused by electrical issues. Now in the summer of 2024 our dishwasher quit working correctly. The motor has died in the main wash assembly. It would cost more than $600 as the entire bottom of the unit must be replaced. Since 3 of our 4 expensive KitchenAid appliances have failed I asked the technician about our very pricy oven which he warned us that if the heating element on the bottom goes out, the removal and repair for it will be astronomical, because of the way it is constructed. [ ] I absolutely love these appliances, they were all top notch and had every feature I could ever want, but I can't believe that I have spent over $10,000 and am having to replace 3 of the 4 in less than 6 years! I CANNOT RECOMMEND ANY KITCHENAID PRODUCT.

Comments (English): [ ***My product, installation and delivery review. ] || ---------------- || 4/5 Stars for the following reasons:Installation/delivery review below, must read.Pros: sleek & quiet; cleans & drys very well (I recommend keeping door closed for 1hr + when you can for optimal drying, it stays warm for a long time); Cons: door is “wobbly”, must open/close with middle of towel bar; small capacity (much less than my previous, mind you the Samsung didn't last 3 years); the dish/cup placement pegs are not terribly user friendly to the eye. The cup shelf especially, its been challenging figure out the best layout for loading; water collects in flat placed areas. Costco is great, their initial vendor selection not so much. I've had really bad experiences in the past, with water delivery though it has improved. As it relates to this purchase, the first company they sent DCC (SoCal, greater Long Beach) was disappointing. The DCC tech was rough around the edges. Upon inspecting the area before bringing my unit up, he said that my height clearance was not enough. The product measured 34 1/16” H and my space was 34 1/4”. He said I need at least an inch of clearance while the website desc noted less needed. The tech refused to attempt and then reported to Costco that I only had a 34 1/8” clearance. I went back & forth with Costco Logistics in Cerritos who were great! They communicated well and sent a different vendor, Options Plumbing, that knocked it out of the park! Options installed the dishwasher with no issues. They were professional and personable. 2 techs vs the 1 from DCC. Options saved me and Costco the hassle of a refund etc. plus their scheduling contact (I think Marina? ) was pleasant to deal with.
